intro.title: Comprehensive Business Solutions
intro.text: Five Investment Limited provides professional services to government institutions, NGOs, private companies, development partners, and communities throughout South Sudan. Our experienced team delivers high-quality solutions with a strong commitment to safety, efficiency, and client satisfaction.

items.question: Do you work with NGOs and UN agencies?
items.answer: Yes, we have extensive experience supplying goods and services to humanitarian and development organisations.

items.question: Do you provide services outside Juba?
items.answer: Absolutely. We operate across all ten states of South Sudan and can deploy teams nationwide.

items.question: Can you handle large‑scale construction projects?
items.answer: Yes, we have the equipment, skilled workforce, and experience to manage major infrastructure projects.

items.question: Do you supply goods nationwide?
items.answer: Yes, our procurement and logistics network reaches every region of South Sudan.

items.question: Can I request a custom quotation?
items.answer: Certainly. Contact us with your requirements and we will prepare a tailored quotation.

items.question: How quickly can you start a project?
items.answer: Timelines depend on the scope, but we pride ourselves on rapid mobilisation once an agreement is signed.

callToAction.title: Ready to Work With Five Investment Limited?
callToAction.text: Whether you need construction, procurement, agriculture, logistics, or industrial services, our team is ready to deliver dependable solutions tailored to your needs.
